headline: Frontlines Flare as Bases Exchange Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has sharpened on six fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, logging twenty‑six ownership changes in the past day; Colonial dead have risen to 157,756 and Warden dead to 173,711, with both casualty streams now cooling after a brief Warden surge. Fishermans Row, previously the hottest zone, has slipped to twenty‑five flips, its Colonial losses modest at fifty‑eight while Warden losses climb to one‑forty‑nine and enlistments continue to cool. Linn Mercy still drives heavy fighting around Lathair, recording sixteen flips, 50,008 Colonial and 61,229 Warden casualties, and a sharp acceleration in both casualty rates despite slowing recruitment. Mooring County holds steady at eleven flips but sees a steep 24‑hour rise of 2,939 Colonial and 2,625 Warden dead, with all rate trends now cooling sharply. Stlican Shelf records thirteen flips, casualties climbing to 50,518 Colonial and 55,880 Warden, the latest hour showing accelerating losses before a broader cooling trend. Stonecradle’s activity has eased to eight flips, yet Colonial casualties reach 40,075 and Warden 47,595, with Warden losses accelerating while Colonial and enlistment rates cool. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain static, reporting no ownership changes.
